applies_to.withdrawn_phrase: Perpart render switchesmodel type and applies baby.75/adult1scale.

correction: Head EntityAnaconda overrides getScale: baby0.75/adult1. EntityAnacondaPart has no getScale override; it extends LivingEntity whose selected getScale returns baby0.5/adult1. Part renderer and tickMultipartPosition call part getScale, so do not transfer head0.75 to parts. Dynamic dispatch of isBaby uses part synced BABY copied from head. This is literal selected source evidence, not measured baby pose/seam or a Dynasty bug.
